content: Accessible turn-based/board game UIs wrap the game log or last-move/status text in an aria-live='polite' region so screen readers announce moves and whose turn it is without polling. Interactive cells need roving tabindex or standard tab order, Enter/Space activation, aria-pressed/aria-label per cell, and visible focus indicators. Avoid overusing live regions (noise); only announce state that changes from user or game actions. Real screen-reader testing (not just automated audits) is recommended.
